name: Clinic Selection — User Selects Clinic, Bot Confirms
goal: User selects a clinic from the rich media widget; bot thanks and confirms clinic name.
constraints: Clinic selection must be via widget, not typed.

phases.description: Bot renders clinic selection widget; user selects a clinic.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot thanks user, displays name of selected clinic, and confirms booking.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
